calculation.description: Per-asset 60-day rolling beta to US10Y minus 60-day rolling beta to CN10Y (yield-curve sensitivity spread), then cross-sectionally z-scored with a 250-day rolling window (min 60 obs). High values mean an asset recently loads more on US yield moves than on CN yield moves; the negative 1-day forward IC indicates such assets subsequently underperform, i.e. bond-yield beta spread is a short/defensive signal.

validation.regime_notes: Evaluation spans 2021-01-04..2026-07-15 (2019 cross-sectional dates in eval window; factor valid on >=8 instruments on 430 dates). Cross-asset universe of 15 tradable instruments (equity indices, commodities, crypto, yields). Macro observation series DXY/USDJPY/EURUSD/USDCNY/VIX used only for regime context. Candidate from yield-curve sensitivity family with no prior library representation; pooled rho vs all 14 effective library factors <= 0.017, well below 0.5 diversity gate.
